issues.display_title: Issue #1: Migration Street Builder from Electron to Tauri
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Migration of the GoThru Street Builder desktop application from the legacy Electron (v1.2.14) architecture to Tauri v2 + Rust (crates/sb-core) + React 19 + TypeScript.

This migration achieves:

  • Substantially Lower Resource Footprint: Minimal RAM consumption and dramatically reduced binary package size.
  • Enhanced Security: Elimination of shell executions; external binaries are driven strictly via argument vectors (SidecarCommand).
  • High-Performance Rendering: Hardware-accelerated 360° equirectangular WebGL panorama viewer paired with MapLibre GL vector mapping.
  • Modern & Precise UI/UX: Retaining the exact workflow from Electron v1.2.14 while polishing visual alignment, keyboard accessibility, and state feedback.

Architectural Principles & Core Implementation

1. Rust Core Engine (crates/sb-core & src-tauri)

  • Media Ingest Pipeline:
    • 360° video frame extraction powered by ffmpeg with real-time carriage-return stderr progress parsing.
    • Batch EXIF geotag extraction from timelapse image sequence directories using exiftool.
    • Automatic discovery and parsing of companion GPS telemetry (.insv or .gpx).
  • GPS Maths & Selection Engine:
    • Track normalization saved directly to gps/track.json.
    • Distance selection algorithm (walk spacing, thresholding, and point filtering) ported with 100% golden test parity against legacy Electron (open.js & measure-distance.js), supporting both Layers/Frames mode and GPS mode (meters/feet).
    • Automatic bearing/heading calculations between successive GPS coordinates.
  • Upload & Network Engine:
    • Direct integration with GoThru Constellation API (https://api.gothru.co).
    • Resumable uploads with pause, resume, and per-frame retry capabilities.
    • Authentication tokens securely stored in the native OS Keychain / Credential Manager.

2. Modern Presentation Layer (src/)

  • React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Zustand:
    • Clean modular state management (projectsStore, framesStore, uploadStore, authStore).
  • 360° Panorama Viewer (Photo Sphere Viewer 5):
    • WebGL-accelerated equirectangular panorama rendering via @photo-sphere-viewer/core.
    • Dynamic aspect ratio calculation (2:1 stitched vs 1:1 dual fisheye) and prevention of WebGL context race conditions.
    • Full compatibility with Tauri's custom asset protocol (asset.localhost).
  • Interactive GPS Map (MapLibre GL):
    • Route polyline rendering with interactive markers and automatic bounding-box fitting.
  • Ingest Dropzone Parity:
    • Matches Electron v1.2.14 UI: Drag-and-drop area with dedicated Add video (.mp4, .m4v, .mov) and Add time lapse (image sequence folders) buttons.
    • Pop-up warning modal for unstitched raw files (.insv and .360), guiding users to stitch into 2:1 equirectangular MP4s first.
  • Precision Toolbar & Carousel:
    • Symmetrically aligned toolbar containers (uniform 140px height with 10px padding and 120px content height).
    • Project carousel supporting both step-scrolling via clicks and continuous smooth scrolling via hover.
    • Comprehensive keyboard accessibility (WCAG / :focus-visible) and active thumbnail border highlights on the timeline strip.

Completed Milestones

  • Authentication: Manual email/password login, Google OAuth via custom deep-link scheme (streetbuilder://), and keychain session persistence.
  • Video Ingest: Support for .mp4, .m4v, and .mov with companion GPS telemetry (.insv/.gpx).
  • Timelapse Ingest: Image sequence directory ingest, batch EXIF GPS extraction, frame renumbering, and route generation.
  • Viewer & Map Sync: Synchronized Split view, Map view, and Panorama view modes.
  • Distance & Marker Selection: Full support for both GPS distance spacing and frame layer step configurations.
  • GoThru Upload: End-to-end verified with live publishing to GoThru API (e.g., Tour Moderation ID 3583815).
  • UI/UX Precision & Hardening: Symmetrical toolbar containers, carousel navigation, timeline feedback, and keyboard a11y.
  • Quality Assurance: Unit test suites (vitest), linter (eslint + prettier), and Rust verification (cargo check / cargo clippy) passing 100%.

Technology Stack

  • Desktop Framework: Tauri v2
  • Backend Core: Rust (tokio, serde, reqwest, keyring)
  • Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, SCSS Modules, Zustand
  • 3D & Mapping: Photo Sphere Viewer 5, MapLibre GL
  • External Sidecars: FFmpeg, ExifTool

issues.display_title: Issue #6: fix(auth): Fix Google OAuth deep-link callback forwarding and scheme registration on desktop
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Resolve Google OAuth sign-in flow failure on desktop (Windows/Linux) where redirecting back through the deep-link URL (streetbuilder://) failed to complete authentication while the application was already open.

Root Causes

  1. Single-Instance Argument Dropped: On Windows/Linux, deep-link protocol activation launches a secondary application process with the OAuth callback URL as a CLI argument. The tauri-plugin-single-instance callback focused the window but discarded _argv, preventing tauri-plugin-deep-link from dispatching the event to on_open_url.
  2. Missing Scheme Registration in Development: The streetbuilder protocol scheme was not dynamically registered on startup, causing system URI invocations to target legacy or previously installed binaries instead of the active executable.
  3. Silent Failure in UI: LoginScreen.tsx did not subscribe to failure outcomes from the auth:google-complete event, leaving the login form in a frozen/busy state without displaying error messages.

Changes Made

  • Single-Instance CLI Forwarding (src-tauri/src/lib.rs): Forwarded argv to app.deep_link().handle_cli_arguments(argv.into_iter()) in the single-instance callback.
  • Dynamic Scheme Registration & Startup Fallback (src-tauri/src/lib.rs): Added app.deep_link().register_all() on startup and checked app.deep_link().get_current() to support cold-start launches.
  • UI Error Feedback (src/features/auth/components/LoginScreen.tsx): Added onGoogleComplete listener to catch status: "err", display error messages, and reset button busy state.
  • Diagnostic Tracing (src-tauri/src/commands/auth.rs): Added structured logging across PKCE generation, system browser invocation, and token exchange.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Clicking "Continue with Google" opens the OAuth consent screen in the system default browser.
  • Deep-link redirection (streetbuilder://?code=...&state=...) from https://gothru.co/success.html is received by the primary application instance.
  • CSRF state and PKCE verifier validate successfully, exchanging the authorization code for an id_token and authenticating against Gothru API.
  • Session is saved to native OS keychain and the user transitions to the authenticated view.
  • Any authentication error or cancellation surfaces feedback to the user on the login screen.
  • All checks pass (cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings, pnpm test, pnpm lint).
